meta.title: Timezone Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: View and compare real-time clocks across 35+ world cities. DST handled automatically via the built-in Intl API.
steps_timezone-converter_1Desc: Default cities show major time zones. Search and add any of 35+ world cities to your view. Each card shows the current local time updated every second.
steps_timezone-converter_2Desc: See real-time clocks for all selected cities. Toggle custom date/time to plan meetings — set a candidate time and check what hour it is in every city.
steps_timezone-converter_3Desc: Use the overview to identify overlap windows where all participants have reasonable working hours. Remove cities you don't need for a cleaner view.
desc: View and compare real-time clocks across 35+ world cities. DST handled automatically via the built-in Intl API.
